# MID PENN BANK DONATES $100,000 TO PENN MEDICINE’S BASSER CENTER FOR BRCA


Posted on Nov 17th, 2026


Harrisburg, Pa., November 17, 2026 — Mid Penn Bank (the “Bank”), a wholly owned subsidiary of Mid Penn Bancorp, Inc. (“Mid Penn”) (Nasdaq: MPB), is proud to continue its support of the Basser Center for BRCA at Penn Medicine (“Basser Center”) with a $100,000 donation. Mid Penn Bank President and CEO Rory Ritrievi and MPB Financial Chief Revenue Officer and Private Bank President Jordan Space presented the donation to Basser Center representatives Kevin Mahoney and Dr. Payal Shah during a check presentation on October 29. The contribution was made through proceeds raised during the 2026 Mid Penn Bank Celebrity Golf Classic, which took place in July.


The Basser Center, part of Penn Medicine’s Abramson Center, is the first comprehensive center dedicated to the research, treatment and prevention of BRCA-related cancers. BRCA gene mutations can increase the risk of several cancers, including breast, ovarian, pancreatic and prostate cancers, and can affect both women and men. The center brings together researchers, physicians, genetic counselors and other experts to find better ways to prevent and treat these hereditary cancers.


“The work being done by the Basser Center is helping people better understand hereditary cancer risk and giving families knowledge that can shape important decisions about their health,” Ritrievi said. “That research can lead to earlier action, better outcomes and more options for the future, and we are honored to contribute to that work.”


Through Mid Penn Bank’s support, the Basser Center continues its efforts to better understand BRCA-related cancers and improve prevention, treatment and care for those affected. The contribution will also support initiatives focused on earlier detection and intervention.


Now in its 11th year, the Mid Penn Bank Celebrity Golf Classic brings together celebrity guests, sponsors, volunteers and community partners each summer to raise awareness and funding for breast cancer research, advocacy and care. The 2026 event supported the PA Breast Cancer Coalition, the Basser Center for BRCA at Penn Medicine and Cooper Norcross Health.


### About Mid Penn Bank


Mid Penn Bank, headquartered in Millersburg, Pennsylvania, has been serving the community since 1868. The Bank operates 59 retail locations throughout Pennsylvania and central and southern New Jersey, and has total assets of over $7 billion. Mid Penn offers a comprehensive portfolio of financial products and services to meet the banking needs of the communities it serves.
